entries.0cde23dabf34db29: The “New Medium-Term Management Plan 2029,” formulated on July 8, 2026 (covering the fiscal years ended May 2027 to May 2029), sets the corporate brand message “Tech Driven Value for Growth.” It aims to become a group of Only one Tech Driven-type Disclosure & IR companies in the disclosure and IR field, and as its growth strategy it promotes the evolution of WizLabo, its core business, group collaboration and synergy, and efforts in human capital management.

entries.202cdd36a6e2809d: Since its founding in 1952, the company has built expertise in preparing disclosure documents and a document-preparation support framework centered on WizLabo, and the MD&A states that in 2025 it handled listing support for a majority of newly listed companies. In the interpreting business, the company is said to have secured a high repeat rate, and orders for large projects are reported to be growing.

entries.38bb6c39d0a518dc: In disclosure support for domestic listed companies, demand driven by regulatory changes continues, including digitalization of the shareholders’ meeting process, disclosure of sustainability information, and compliance with SSBJ standards, and the Disclosure-Related Business is the company’s largest business by consolidated revenue. In the Interpreting and Translation Business, demand is supported by the holding of international conferences and large-scale events.
entries.3b585bb216df4337: The strategy appears to be to bring in areas adjacent to statutory disclosure by adding AI to WizLabo and strengthening disclosure-process consulting and BPO, and to expand financial product disclosure offerings through M&A, such as consolidating J Trust. In the Interpreting and Translation Business, the company intends to respond to structural change in the industry brought about by AI with new offerings such as AI translation platforms.
